analysis_design: Repeated nested CV estimates con0053 -> pain_48_arm performance. A final full-sample con0053 model is then back-projected to raw voxel space; its weight map is dot-multiplied with con0053-con0056. Ordinary full-sample regressions test con0054 score vs pain_46_arm, con0055 score vs pain_48_leg, and con0056 score vs pain_46_leg.
known_limitation: The same participants contribute con0053 training data to the full-sample weight map and con0054-con0056 images to the transfer regressions; therefore those regressions are not fully independent out-of-sample tests.
feature_mask: Hoeppli high-heat positive/negative union intersected with present-study group coverage
signature_score_definition: raw masked contrast vector dot raw back-projected con0053 LASSO-PCR voxel-weight vector; no intercept
